services.name: Rafting Trips
services.desc: We understand that not everyone wants their outdoor experience to involve barreling down the river at full tilt, being tossed around gleefully by the whitewater. (After all, you might be visiting Golden with older family members, young children or those who prefer not to feel like they are in the spin cycle of a washing machine. Continuous rapids aren’t everyone’s cup of tea!) If a peaceful, beautiful float down the river sounds like it’s more your speed, you’ll love our Family Rafting adventure. blurb: Take a break in the fresh air of the BC backcountry on one of our rafting and camping tours. You’ll be sleeping under the stars in the wild and untamed Canadian Rockies, surrounded by six of the most stunning national parks in the country - Mount Revelstoke, Kootenay, Jasper, Banff, Glacier and Yoho.
